No. GIFT/RFP/MRKT/2026/23 Bid Number: GEM/2026/B/8252872 Venue: GIFT City Club, GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat th th th Event Dates: 10 , 11 and 12 January 2027 Invitation

Gujarat International Finance Tec-City Company Limited (hereinafter referred to as "GIFTCL" or "the Autho rity") invites online bids from reputed, experienced and financially sound Event Management Agencies for planning, conceptualisation, designing, coordination, management and execution of the Vibrant Gujarat 20 27 – GIFT City Conference scheduled to be organised at GIFT City Club, GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, fr om 10th to 12th January 2027. The selected agency shall be responsible for end-to-end event management, including infrastructure devel opment, conference arrangements, stage and venue setup, branding, audio-visual systems, LED installatio ns, live streaming, guest management, protocol arrangements, hospitality coordination, photography, vide ography, manpower deployment, safety management and all other associated services as specified in this RFP. The agency shall execute the project under the supervision and direction of GIFTCL and in coordination wit h the concerned Government Departments, protocol authorities, venue management and other stakeholde rs. Scope of Work The selected Event Management Agency shall be responsible for the end-to-end planning, conceptualisatio n, design, execution, management and successful completion of the event, including, but not limited to, th e following activities: 1. Event Conceptualization: Conceptualisation and development of the overall event theme, creative c oncept and experience in line with the objectives and requirements of GIFTCL. 2. Event Planning and Designing: Preparation and submission of event design, venue layout, stage des ign and production plans, 3D visualization and execution scheduled for approval. 3. Conference Infrastructure: Complete conference infrastructure and furniture arrangements and oth er necessary facilities. 4. Stage and Technical Production: Stage fabrication, LED screens, sound, lighting and AV systems and other associated technical infrastructure. 5. Branding & Signage: Branding, signage, entrance gates and thematic installations and other promot ional elements. 6. VIP/VVIP Management: VIP and VVIP protocol arrangements. 7. Guest Registration & Hospitality Management: End-to-end management of Guest registration and h ospitality management, Guest Assistance. 8. Manpower deployment: Deployment of experienced event managers, coordinators, technical operat ors, hostesses and support staff for smooth execution of the event. 9. Media related service: Live streaming, photography, videography and recording & Post event media documentation. 10. Safety & Security Management: Security coordination, fire safety, housekeeping and emergency pre paredness. 11. Stakeholder coordination: Coordination with GIFTCL, Government representatives, venue managem ent and other stakeholders to ensure seamless event execution. 12. Dismantling and Site restoration: Dismantling, removal of temporary infrastructure and restoration of the venue followed by proper cleaning and restoration of the venue to its original condition. 13. Post event reports: Submission of comprehensive final reports, photographs, videos and event docu mentation. The detailed scope and BOQ shall form an integral part of this tender. Event Overview The event shall be organised at GIFT City Club, GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, for three days, from 10th to 12th January 2027. The broad event requirements are as follows: 10 January 2027 – U-Shaped Conference Conference arrangement for approximately 50 delegates. U-shaped conference table arrangement. Premium revolving chairs. Professional sound and microphone arrangements.

LED screens and display infrastructure. VIP/VVIP protocol arrangements. Floral decorations. Conference branding and signage. All necessary technical and operational support. 11 and 12 January 2027 – Theatre-Style Conference Theatre-style seating arrangement for approximately 300 participants. Stage and backdrop arrangements. LED screens and technical infrastructure. Professional sound and lighting. Podiums and microphones. Live streaming arrangements. Video recording and photography. Conference branding and signage. Guest management and hospitality. Technical and operational manpower. Common Arrangements The selected agency shall arrange all common facilities for the event, including: LED televisions. VIP lounge furniture. Conference tables and seating. Branding and signage. Entry gates. Selfie points. Delegate kits. Mementos. Bouquets and floral decorations. Hostesses and guest relations executives. Event anchor. Registration desk. Event management personnel. Photography and videography. Recording facilities. Lighting and power distribution. Fire extinguishers. Housekeeping and security personnel. Detailed BOQ The detailed BOQ containing the following three sections shall be attached as Breakup excel: Detailed BOQ: The Bidder shall fill, sign, stamp, and submit the Financial Break-up Excel upload in financi al Document. The total amount, inclusive of all taxes, duties, levies, and other costs, shall be quoted as a s ingle lump-sum price in the Financial Price Bid. Section A: U-Shaped Conference Setup – 10 January 2027. Section B: Conference Setup – 11 and 12 January 2027. Section C: Common Items for Three Days. The bidder shall quote against all items and quantities specified in Annexure A. The BOQ supplied with the tender shall be treated as the governing schedule of quantities, subject to appr oved clarifications and corrigenda. No additional payment shall be made for items or services that are reasonably necessary for satisfactory e xecution of the specified scope but have been omitted from the bidder's internal cost calculations.

EXECUTION AND PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS Project Management and Coordination The selected agency shall nominate one dedicated Project Director/Project Manager as the single point of c ontact for GIFTCL. The agency shall deploy sufficient qualified manpower for planning, coordination, installation, event operat ions and dismantling. The agency shall submit a detailed execution plan within 3 days of issuance of the Work Order. The agency shall provide the following documents for approval: Detailed event layout. Stage and backdrop designs. Branding and signage designs. Furniture layout. Electrical and lighting layout. Audio-visual equipment specifications. Technical production plan. Manpower deployment chart. Safety and emergency response plan. Installation and dismantling schedule. No major installation or fabrication shall be undertaken without approval of GIFTCL. The agency shall attend all review and coordination meetings as required by GIFTCL. The agency shall ensure that the project is executed in accordance with the approved concept, BOQ, speci fications and timeline. Quality Standards The agency shall ensure: a. All equipment and materials are new or in excellent working condition. b. All furniture, carpets, decorations and installations are of premium quality. c. LED screens have appropriate resolution, brightness and display quality. d. Sound systems are professionally configured and tested. e. All electrical installations comply with applicable safety standards. f. All manpower is suitably trained, professionally dressed and identifiable. g. All branding materials are printed and installed to the approved specifications. h. All installations are structurally stable and safe. i. All technical equipment is tested before the commencement of the event. GIFTCL reserves the right to reject any material, equipment or installation that does not meet the approve d specifications. Testing and Rehearsals The agency shall complete installation and testing before the scheduled event commencement. A full technical rehearsal shall be conducted before the event. All microphones, speakers, LED screens, lighting, internet connections, streaming systems and recording e quipment shall be tested. The agency shall maintain backup equipment for critical systems.

Any technical malfunction during the event shall be rectified immediately. The agency shall deploy dedicated technical personnel throughout the event. Live Streaming and Recording The agency shall: Provide professional live streaming infrastructure. Ensure stable internet connectivity. Deploy trained vision mixing operators. Provide appropriate cameras and recording systems. Maintain backup recording and storage. Ensure that audio and video quality is maintained. Submit the final event recordings and digital deliverables to GIFTCL. No live streaming, publication or sharing of event-related content shall be undertaken without prior approv al from GIFTCL. Manpower and Deployment The agency shall deploy the manpower specified in the BOQ. All personnel shall be experienced, professionally trained and suitably dressed. The agency shall submit a list of key personnel before deployment. Replacement of key personnel shall require prior approval of GIFTCL. The agency shall ensure adequate backup manpower. The agency shall be solely responsible for salaries, wages, statutory contributions, insurance, transportatio n, food and other employment-related obligations of its personnel. No employer-employee relationship shall arise between GIFTCL and the agency's deployed personnel. The agency shall comply with applicable labour laws, minimum wage requirements, EPF, ESI and other stat utory provisions, wherever applicable. Safety and Security The agency shall prepare and implement a comprehensive safety plan covering: Fire prevention and firefighting. Electrical safety. Structural stability of stage and truss. Crowd management. Emergency evacuation. First-aid arrangements and emergency coordination. Safe cable routing. Equipment safety. Incident reporting. Emergency response coordination. All electrical and temporary structural installations shall be undertaken by qualified personnel. The agency shall ensure that fire extinguishers are valid, functional and positioned at appropriate locations . The agency shall immediately report any accident, injury, fire, property damage or other safety incident to GIFTCL. The agency shall be responsible for damages or injuries arising from its negligence, unsafe installations or failure to comply with applicable safety requirements. INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS
